metadata.subject: MATHEMATICS

general_instructions: All questions are compulsory. Internal choices are provided in selected questions.
Section A comprises Objective / Assertion-Reason questions of 1 mark each.
Section B comprises Very Short Answer questions of 2 marks each.
Section C comprises Short Answer questions of 3 marks each.
Section D comprises Long Answer / Case-study questions of 5 marks each.
Step calculations and SI units are mandatory for numerical questions.

sections.instruction: Select the correct option. Each question carries 1 mark.

questions.text: Which of the following algebraic identities is universally correct for all real values of a and b?
Pressure is defined as the force acting per unit area of a surface. Its standard S.I. unit is:
Which agricultural method is recognized as the most water-efficient modern irrigation system?
The British land revenue settlement that fixed the revenue demand permanently without periodic revision was:

ASSERTION (A): The shoulder strap of a school bag is made broad.
REASON (R): A broad strap increases the surface area of contact, thereby reducing the pressure exerted on the shoulder.
options: (a) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
(b) Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A).

sections.section_title: SECTION B — VERY SHORT ANSWER QUESTIONS
sections.instruction: Answer the following questions in 20–30 words. Each question carries 2 marks.

questions.text: Factorise the algebraic expression completely by grouping terms: 15xy - 6x + 5y - 2.
State two distinct physiological differences between Plant Cells and Animal Cells regarding cell wall and vacuole size.
Why is rolling friction substantially less than sliding friction? Give one practical engineering application where sliding friction is replaced by rolling friction.

sections.section_title: SECTION C — SHORT ANSWER & NUMERICAL QUESTIONS
sections.instruction: Answer the following questions step-by-step. Each question carries 3 marks.

questions.text: A wooden block of dimensions 20 cm x 10 cm x 5 cm of mass 4 kg is kept on a tabletop. Calculate the maximum pressure exerted by the block on the tabletop in Pascals. (Take g = 10 m/s²).
The perimeter of a rectangular swimming pool is 154 m. Its length is 2 m more than twice its breadth. Find the length and breadth of the pool step-by-step.
Explain three major economic causes that triggered widespread discontent among Indian peasants and artisans during the Revolt of 1857.

sections.section_title: SECTION D — LONG ANSWER & CASE-BASED INTEGRATED TASKS
sections.instruction: Answer the following detailed questions. Each question carries 5 marks.

questions.text:
(a) A closed cylindrical storage tank of radius 7 m and height 3 m is made from a sheet of metal. How much sheet of metal is required? (Take π = 22/7).
(b) If the metal costs ₹ 45 per square meter, calculate the total cost of metal used.

(a) Draw a neat labeled diagram of a Plant Cell showing at least 4 key organelles.
(b) State the specific function of: (i) Mitochondria, and (ii) Chloroplast.

CASE STUDY: An organic farmer in Dharmapuri tests two identical soil plots. Plot A is treated with biological compost and cow dung manure. Plot B is treated with continuous chemical urea and ammonium sulfate.
(i) State two long-term ecological advantages observed in Plot A regarding soil texture and water retention. [2]
(ii) Why does excessive chemical fertilizer usage degrade soil fertility over multiple seasons? [2]
(iii) What biological process restores nitrogen naturally to agricultural soil? [1]
